description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to land parcels in Alakoladeniya, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420204 and to 12 other land parcels
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of notices calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act, specifically dealing with land ownership, possession, and interest determinations for various land parcels across multiple districts. The content focuses exclusively on land-related matters including land titles, cadastral maps, and land claim processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
